snippet.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley's new expansion, The Keepsake Sea, launches in November 2026 for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch!

Become friends with Milo Thatch, Jack Sparrow, and Megara as you embark on an adventure to reach a faraway kingdom across the sea and discover strange echoes of its past. This expansion brings a brand-new epic storyline, new unique Biomes to explore, and new underwater areas to uncover and fully customize!

#NintendoDirect #DisneyDreamlightValley
